'''Ramchak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who served aboard the [[airship]] ''[[Bloodskull]]'' during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].

==Biography==
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on the ''[[Bloodskull]]'' [[Attack on the Windrunner|attacked]] the [[House Dooku]] airship [[Windrunner/Legends|''Windrunner'']] with the intention of capturing [[Bron Dooku]]. During the battle, Ramchak fought in hand-to-hand combat with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent [[Jahan Cross]]. Cross overpowered the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]], and went on to destroy the ''Bloodskull'' by commandeering one of its deck-mounted [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], using it to blow a hole in the hull. Ramchak and the rest of his crew later surrendered and were sent to [[Spike (Serenno)/Legends|the Spike]]. Cross later released Ramchak and his crew to use them as a distraction so he could free [[Aveca Dunn]] from the [[Prison/Legends|prison]].
